en.headline: Very Hot Weather Warning remains in force as extreme heat continues
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory keeps the Very Hot Weather Warning active into Sunday, with mainly fine and extremely hot conditions expected and temperatures forecast to reach 36 degrees Celsius in urban areas.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Very Hot Weather Warning remained in force early on Sunday as extreme heat continued under the influence of the outer subsiding airstream associated with Severe Typhoon Dolphin.

At 2 a.m. the Observatory recorded 31 degrees Celsius with relative humidity of 79 per cent. The warning advises the public to stay alert, drink more water and take protective measures against the heat. Elderly people, pregnant women, infants and children, those with chronic illnesses and the obese are more vulnerable to heat stroke.

The forecast for Sunday is mainly fine and extremely hot during the day, with temperatures ranging from 29 to 36 degrees Celsius. West to northwest winds of force 4, occasionally force 5 on high ground, are expected. The probability of significant rain is low. Extreme heat is forecast to persist into early next week.

zh.headline: 酷熱天氣警告仍然生效 極端酷熱天氣持續
zh.dek: 天文台表示酷熱天氣警告於周日早上仍然生效，預料大致天晴，日間極端酷熱，市區最高氣溫約36度。
body: 香港天文台表示，受強颱風白海豚外圍下沉氣流影響，酷熱天氣警告於周日凌晨仍然生效，極端酷熱天氣持續。
凌晨2時，天文台錄得氣溫31度，相對濕度百分之79。警告提醒市民提高警惕，多補充水分及做足防暑措施。長者、孕婦、嬰兒及小童、慢性病患者以及過胖人士較易中暑。
周日預測大致天晴，日間極端酷熱，氣溫介乎29至36度，吹西至西北風4級，高地間中5級，顯著降雨概率低。預料本週初極端酷熱天氣持續。
